prompt: texinfo-format-region missing closing brace error message
answer:
`texinfo-format-region` may report a missing closing brace as:

```text
Unbalanced parentheses
```

rather than `Unbalanced braces`. It checks brace mismatches as though they were parentheses. To locate the error, switch to the `*Info Region*` buffer; the cursor will be positioned after the detected error.
